prompt: The same forest clearing, same framing, same trees, finish gate, moon and mountains as the reference, same painterly hanji-paper grain, simple large masses, no lace, no patterns. Five round paper lanterns hang on thin cords from the top edge, glowing warm amber. The sky is a natural Korean country sunset afterglow, like a real dusk photograph painted in muted traditional colours: near the horizon and around the gate a soft warm peach, apricot and honey orange, rising through pale dusty yellow-grey into a muted slate blue, then deep navy only at the very top. The far ridges are warm muted brown-orange fading with distance, the mist is pale apricot. Earthy, calm, low saturation. STRICTLY NO purple, NO violet, NO lavender, NO magenta, NO pink anywhere: warm colours go directly to grey-blue. The tree masses stay dark with no glowing outline and no rim light. The dark foreground ground has a faint warm sheen in the centre. ABSOLUTELY NO characters, animals or people: the foreground stays open for puppets.
